note: The bands the Radian plant has to land in, from docs/GLIDER-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the E-flite Radian and Radian Pro (scripts/glider-derive.js prints the derived figures). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

g1_glide.source: L/D power off, the prop folded, at 8 m/s, derived 18.7 (best 18.9 at 7.5); a Radian's glide is well over 15

g2_min_sink.source: power off, the least sink over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 0.379 at 7.1 m/s

g3_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 6.49; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.05 / 5.709, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 5.336 (scripts/glider-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 5.709: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.18391. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.050 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.072, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.050 / 1.122) = 0.9676.

g4_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 9.59 at 15.2 m/s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 5.81 at 11.6 m/s on the straight line, which under-read the thrust at speed; the band the same 0.69 to 1.19 of the derived (was 4.0 to 6.9), and the sweep moved with the best climb speed it brackets (was 9 to 14 m/s)

g5_level.source: level at 65 percent throttle, derived 17.14. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 14.05 on the straight line; the band the same 0.868 to 1.153 of the derived (was 12.2 to 16.2)

g6_roll.source: full aileron from level at 65 percent: the helix angle pb/2V, derived 0.111, 77 deg/s at 12 m/s

g7_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

g8_sideslip.source: full rudder, wings held level: -Cndr dr / Cnb, derived 17.8, the wind from the left

g9_yaw_rate.source: full rudder from level at 65 percent, ailerons centred: the Dutch roll step's peak rate, derived 115 at the 17.14 m/s that holds. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the 65 percent speed rose, so the rate with it, was 94 at 14.05 m/s; the band the same 0.67 to 1.49 of the derived (was 63 to 140)

g10_rudder_roll.source: full rudder from level at 65 percent, ailerons centred: bank after 2 s, the rudder's way, from the polyhedral; steady roll rate derived 70 deg/s at 17.14 m/s once the sideslip is built, about 106 deg by 2 s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the 65 percent speed rose and the roll rate goes with V, was 58 deg/s at 14.05 m/s, about 87 deg by 2 s; the band the same 0.345 to 1.38 of the derived (was 30 to 120)

g11_fold.source: at 8 m/s: folded under 5 percent throttle, no thrust and nothing turning; open at 5 percent the prop brakes by -Ts d^2 ct(V / (Vp d)), the curve carried on along its last two tenths past mu 2 as the plant does, derived 0.128 N. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 0.106 N on the straight line Ts d^2 (V / (Vp d) - 1); the band the same 0.566 to 1.51 of the derived (was 0.06 to 0.16)

g12_glide_open.source: L/D at 8 m/s with the prop open at 5 percent, derived 14.96 against 18.7 folded. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the open prop brakes harder on the curve, was 15.5; the band the same 0.839 to 1.148 of the derived (was 13.0 to 17.8)

g13_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.092, 80 percent of the measured electrical power 0.225

g14_thermal.source: circling at 30 deg and 8.5 m/s centred on the 2.5 m/s thermal: rise at 12.8 m, 2.11, less the turn's sink, 0.52, derived 1.59

g15_still.source: the same circle where the air is still: the turn's sink, derived 0.52

g16_topped.source: the same circle over the thermal's top, 300 m: the still air's sink again

g17_throw.source: the shell's throw, 10 m/s, at 70 percent, for two seconds the stick that trims a 10 m/s climb there (5.2 deg of elevator through the expo; neutral trims the 7.7 m/s glide): airborne and flying after three. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the climb at 70 percent steepens from 10.2 to 18.5 deg, was -0.274, 4.8 deg

g18_chop.source: throttle off from level at 65 percent, the pitch stick left where level flight had it: a glide, not a tumble

g19_phugoid.source: from level at 65 percent, hands off at the same throttle: the elevator neutral trims a 7.2 m/s climb at 18 deg, whose phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model is 5.73 s, zeta -0.005; a glider's phugoid is long and barely damped, zeta near 1/(sqrt 2 L/D). Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 9.75 x 7.5 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/glider-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was a 7.4 m/s climb at 11 deg, 5.64 s, zeta 0.071; the band the same 0.816 to 1.170 of the derived (was 4.6 to 6.6). The steeper climb takes the damping to neutral, so the plant's swing is large

g20_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and the wing's, the Skyhunter's and the Cub's recorded flight hashes in Node, all from before the Radian existed; the Radian must move none of them. Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build, on the owner's approval of the fix on 2026-09-26: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6). The fixed wings' hashes were re-recorded on 2026-09-27 when their packs and tanks began to drain, the owner's decision (docs/POWER-STAGE1.md); the five inch's is unchanged. Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was.

g21_cross_host.source: the Radian's recorded climb, glide and thermal, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
